title: Urban Park Rangers | Post-Thanksgiving Day Super Hike
description: On this Friday, work off your Thanksgiving feast while enjoying the great outdoors. Scramble your way through autumnal Prospect Park with the rangers and your neighbors. Witness plants and wildlife preparing for colder temperatures and get to know one of Brooklyn’s flagship parks. Learn more on the NYC Parks website: Learn More

title: Greenmarket at Grand Army Plaza
description: At what other market can you do all your food shopping, sample local wine and explore Brooklyn’s favorite park? Established in 1989, the Grand Army Plaza greenmarket is the flagship Brooklyn market. EBT/Food Stamps and WIC & Senior FMNP coupons accepted year-round. Learn More For a full calendar of events and a list of sellers, visit the GrowNYC website. Learn about all Nutrition Benefit Programs accepted at GrowNYC Markets.

title: Introduction to Birdwatching Outings
description: Whether you’re new to birding or looking to build your skills, this introductory outing is a great way to explore Prospect Park and learn about the birds that visit throughout the year. Join a member of the Brooklyn Bird Club to learn birding basics and search for the dozens of species found in the park across all seasons. All ages and experience levels are welcome. No registration is required. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. What to Bring: Binoculars if you have them, comfortable walking shoes, water, and weather-appropriate clothing. A limited number of binoculars will be available to borrow. Please Note: Pets are not permitted on this outing. Depending on attendance, participants may be divided into smaller groups. Outings are held rain or shine unless severe weather makes conditions unsafe. Route Description: This outing moves at a relaxed pace with frequent stops to observe birds. Routes may vary from week to week depending on bird activity and park conditions. Participants can expect paved paths, dirt trails, grassy areas, slight inclines and occasional steps. The group will cover approximately 1.5–2 miles. Learn more on the Brooklyn Bird Club website.

title: Sunday Greenmarket at Bartel-Pritchard Square
description: Nestled inside Prospect Park’s tree-shaded southwest corner, this much-loved market is where South Slope and Windsor Terrace residents stock up on locally grown staples. The offerings range from a selection of vegetables, fruits, baked goods, plants and flowers to fresh-caught fish and organic baked goods. Learn More For a full calendar of events and a list of sellers, visit the GrowNYC website. Learn about all Nutrition Benefit Programs accepted at GrowNYC Markets

title: Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit
description: Prospect Park Alliance is collaborating with NewYork-Presbyterian to offer comprehensive sexual health services in Brooklyn’s backyard at Grand Army Plaza every Thursday from 10 am to 3 pm and every Monday at the Parkside + Ocean Avenue Entrance from 10 am to 3 pm. The NewYork-Presbyterian Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit is a safe, inclusive space for people to receive high-quality sexual health services. Learn more about the Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit in Prospect Park or reach out to us at mobilehealth@nyp.org or (929) 923-3543. No insurance or ID is required to receive care. Staffed by a team of NewYork-Presbyterian healthcare providers, the mobile medical unit has an exam room and consult room, and offers routine laboratory testing, vaccinations, and PrEP and PEP medications that lower the risk of HIV infection. Patients can also be connected to social services, benefits enrollment, and local healthcare providers. Other services include sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing, family planning, hepatitis C screening, health education and more. Learn more about the Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit in Prospect Park or reach out to us at mobilehealth@nyp.org. No insurance or ID is required to receive care. The Sexual Health Mobile Medical Unit is made possible through funding from the Dalio Center for Health Justice and the Division of Community and Population Health at NewYork-Presbyterian, and a grant from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Events are subject to change, please check the NYP website for up-to-date information.

title: Lawn and Field Care Volunteering
description: Join Prospect Park Alliance this fall to help spruce up the park’s lawns and sports fields after a busy summer season. Adult volunteers will have the opportunity to help our Lawn and Field staff on a variety of projects. These projects include raking, painting, lawn restoration, and more. Be advised, these projects involve repetitive bending, kneeling, lifting and transporting loaded wheelbarrows. This opportunity requires using sharp tools and encountering potentially hazardous plants and materials. Register online or call (929) 888-6826 for more information.

title: Winter Corps
description: Join Prospect Park Alliance every Thursday from early December through the end of March for Winter Corps, a special seasonal volunteer program! Volunteers will assist with raking, light shoveling, litter pickup and other landscaping projects throughout the park. The group meets at a different location each week. All volunteers who RSVP will receive a reminder email with that week’s meeting location before the event. Appropriate for adults only. Please watch for last-minute cancellations due to winter weather conditions, including extreme cold and heavy snowfall. Register Today For more information, call (929) 888-6826.

title: Grand Army Plaza Menorah Lighting
description: The Largest Menorah in Brooklyn has been towering over New York since 1985 and is a must on everyone’s calendar, Jews and non-Jews alike. Every night of Chanukah, thousands celebrate with the accompaniment of live music and hot latkes for all. Special gifts are distributed to every child. With the assistance of a 60-foot boom lift, Rabbi Shimon Hecht, accompanied by community leaders, philanthropists and special guests light this humongous Menorah. TLM is a leading symbol of Chanukah, publicly reaffirming the celebration of the Jewish community’s freedom. The Menorah lighting celebration and concert are all free of charge. Learn more on the Chabad of Park Slope website. 1st Night of Chanukah, Friday, December 4 at 3:30 pm 2nd Night of Chanukah, Saturday, December 5 at 7:15 pm 3rd Night of Chanukah, Sunday, December 6 at 4:00 pm LIVE CONCERT. title: NYCRUNS Ugly Sweater 5K
description: Join NYCRUNS for the Ugly Sweater 5K in Prospect Park. What’s better than a few festive holiday sweaters? A whole park full of them! Don your most delightfully tacky holiday knit—or whatever you feel most comfortable running in—and embrace the holiday spirit alongside friends, family, and the Brooklyn running community. Every finisher takes home a one-of-a-kind commemorative medal to celebrate crossing the finish line. Learn More

title: FIDO Coffee Bark
description: Coffee Bark is an opportunity for Brooklyn dog owners to chat over coffee and pastries while their dogs romp and play over dog biscuits. With dozens of dogs and people, Coffee Bark is an amazing sight. Look for coffee, pastries, dog biscuits and information about off-leash activities just south of the Picnic House. Hosted by FIDO of Brooklyn, this event is always free! For up to date information about the status of Coffee Bark events in the case of inclement weather, please visit the FIDO in Prospect Park website.

title: Skate with Santa at Lakeside
description: Celebrate the holiday season with a magical skating experience at the LeFrak Center at Lakeside in Prospect Park! Santa Claus is trading his sleigh for a pair of skates and joining us on the ice for a limited time this December! Bring your family and friends for some festive fun as Santa makes special appearances on the rink. Whether you’re a seasoned skater or stepping onto the ice for the first time, this is a holiday experience you won’t want to miss! Learn More Santa’s Skating Schedule Saturdays: December 5, 12 + 19; Sundays: December 6, 13 + 20 Santa’s Appearances: 12:30 pm – 12:45 pm; 2:30 pm – 2:45 pm An Arts & Crafts Table will be set up in the cafe on the same dates as Skate with Santa. Kids will be able to decorate their own ornaments to hang on our Holiday Tree. The ornaments include: an Ice Skate, a Christmas Ornament, a Menorah, and a Kinara For any questions, please contact skatingschool@lefraklakeside.com.

title: Junior Volunteer Corps
description: Join Prospect Park Alliance for our fall Junior Volunteer Corps! On select weekends, families and youth groups are invited to rake leaves at various locations around the park. All necessary tools will be provided. Open to families and youth groups. Families please visit our Volunteer Event Registration Page to preregister. Register as a Family or Register as a Group Register online or call (929) 888-6826 for more information.
